### Are You for Us, or Our Enemies?
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/are-you-for-us-or-our-enemies-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Joshua 5:13-14
Points:
- Believers often view disputes through an "us versus them" lens and plead for God to back their side.
- When Joshua asked whether the armed figure was friend or foe, the Commander flatly answered "Neither."
- The Commander's refusal demonstrates that God does not arrive to serve human factions or personal agendas.
- The central spiritual question is not whether God joins our cause, but whether we choose to join His.
- Faithful prayer follows Jesus in Gethsemane by surrendering our desires to God's overarching kingdom purposes.

### Joshua
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joshua
Passage: Joshua 5:14
Points:
- People instinctively evaluate new encounters to discern whether someone is an ally or an adversary.
- When Joshua presented an either/or choice, the heavenly Commander declined to claim Israel's side.
- Because this Commander received Joshua's worship without rebuke, the encounter points to a Christophany.
- Rather than God enlisting in human campaigns, Christ demands to know if we will submit to His command.
- Believers can step forward in confidence knowing Christ has conquered sin and directs the battle.
